provenance.what: frozen PaddleOCR's reading of each of the 13 stored bay photos with the M29 plan's D5 three models only, as TextBoxes: what crates/ocr's recognize is held to
provenance.recorded_by: M29 P6, a scratch script: preprocess.py's load_image, warp_to_rect (by det_boxes.json's quad), _resize and enhance, then PaddleOCR(lang='en', use_textline_orientation=True, enable_mkldnn=False, use_doc_orientation_classify=False, use_doc_unwarping=False), which is paddle.py's construction with the document preprocessor turned off, and paddle.py's _flatten and _to_text_box on its predict. Its dt_polys were det_boxes.json's sorted boxes exactly on all 13, and its textline_orientation_angles all 0
provenance.five_models: frozen recognize as paddle.py runs it, with the document preprocessor on, is spec/vectors/screen/corpus/'s input.boxes: re-run in the same session on the same working images it gave those boxes exactly on all 13, with the document-orientation model's angle 0 on every photo, so every difference between the two readings is UVDoc's
provenance.boxes: per photo, in the pipeline's reading order: text, x, y, width, height, confidence, as paddle.py's TextBox
